description: This class `Convert` performs data type conversion on a specified field within a map, converting the input value into another type based on the provided configuration, and storing the result under a specified output field. It is used within the mini-language processing framework of Apache OFBiz to facilitate flexible data transformations.

classes.name: Convert
classes.description: A class that converts the value of a specific input field from one data type to another, based on provided parameters, and stores the converted value in an output field, with configurable options for replacing existing values and handling nulls.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the conversion operation based on an XML element configuration and process context.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the conversion operation, transforming a value from the input map and storing it into the results map, with handling for nulls, empty strings, and conversion errors.
